Graceful degradation implemented: LLM/refute failures now write the artifact with deterministic findings + error details instead of losing the whole review

Added ESLint 10 flat config (typescript-eslint recommended, no-explicit-any as warn) + lint-staged; pre-commit hook now runs typecheck, lint-staged, and test:unit; CI runs typecheck + lint before tests

Added 'flaught dashboard' CLI command: reads a directory of findings.json artifacts, computes a chronological trend series (severity/source-type/skeptic-verdict/dismissal counts, LLM failures), and renders a self-contained static HTML page with an inline SVG line chart and a per-run table. First pass scoped deliberately: no automated fetching from GitHub Actions artifact storage (that's a follow-up if wanted) -- point --input at a directory of already-downloaded artifacts.

Fixed a real bug: createRefuteProvider required BOTH refute.provider AND refute.model to be set before honoring either -- setting only refute.model (the same-provider, different-model case) was silently ignored, so the skeptic ran on the exact same model as the reviewer. Fixed to resolve provider/model independently. Configured this project's own .advreview.yml to use openai/gpt-oss-120b as the skeptic (same Groq provider as the 20b reviewer, different model) instead of building a separate multi-provider pipeline -- achieves the same anti-correlation goal. Documented refute.* config in docs/configuration.md (previously undocumented).

Eliminated all 12 no-explicit-any lint warnings. Npm audit parser now uses NpmAuditAdvisory/NpmAuditVulnerability interfaces. All catch blocks use unknown with type narrowing. Dogfood review now reports zero findings.

Implemented configurable retry/backoff for LLM rate limiting.

- Added retries config field (0-5, default 2) to LlmSchema
- Created withRetry() utility with exponential backoff + jitter
- Retry on 429, 5xx, network errors; no retry on 4xx client errors
- Wrapped all three provider review() methods (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama)
- 22 new tests in retry.test.ts

Prevented GitHub token leak via config serialization.

- Made GitHubConfig.token non-enumerable via Object.defineProperty
- Token won't appear in JSON.stringify(), console.log(), or spread operations
- Still accessible via config.token for HTTP Authorization headers
- Applied in both detectGitHubConfig() and CLI manual config path
- Added test verifying token exclusion from JSON/spread/Object.keys

Mitigated LLM prompt injection with data-block delimiters and system constraints.

- Wrapped diff, file contents, and PR description in <data-block> delimiters
  to clearly separate untrusted data from system instructions
- Added DATA INTEGRITY constraint to both review and refute system prompts
  instructing the model to treat data blocks as data, not instructions
- Added 5 tests verifying delimiter wrapping and constraint presence
